title: Mapa RPG de Akihabara Ocupado por Gatos con Diseño Caricaturesco y Lenguaje Felino
prompt: Create a large game map for RPGs based on the actual map of Akihabara. The setting is a cat-occupied Earth, and the entire map should have a cute cartoonish design. All signs and billboards should be written in cat language with paw prints and fish symbols.
